events.title: Employee dies of heart attack, underlying medical conditions…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Universidad Interamericana De Puerto Rico Inc. San Juan, PR. At 4:55 p.m. on August 5, 2024, an employee working for a university was working at her desk performing her administrative duties when she began to feel unwell and collapsed. The employee suffered a heart attack and died, Cause of death wasreported as ischemic and hypertensive heart disease, heart failure, obstructive sleep apnea, and bronchial asthma.

events.title: Employee is killed while working on secondary power line
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Luma Energy Llc Y/O Luma Energy Servco Llc. San Lorenzo, PR. At 12:16 p.m. on May 17, 2024, Employee #1, while working on a secondary power line at a residence, was checking for voltage fluctuations. The task involved repairing and splicing the line. The employees were using a boom lift to perform the work. A coworker, who was facing away from Employee #1, only witnessed the incident when Employee #1 fell inside the lift basket. Employee #1 sustained head trauma, injuries to other parts of the body, and burns on the lower left side of the chest. Employee…

events.title: Employee dies, found unresponsive due to cardiac arrest
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Prime Janitorial Services Corp. San Juan, PR. On February 28, 2023, an employee working as a janitor for a janitorial service was found dead. The employee had died from cardiac arrest.

events.title: Employee suffers medical event in office and dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Sabana Grande, PR. At 1:15 p.m. on January 31, 2023, an employee was working in a municipal office building and was sending a text message on his cell phone when he fainted and fell on top of his desk. The employee was pronounced dead at the scene.

events.title: Employee dies of heart attack
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Supermercados Maximo Inc. Condado, PR. At 12:30 a.m. on October 2, 2022, Employee # 1 was working in an aisle. He fell on the floor. He suffered a heart attack and was killed.

events.description: 1 worker death. Carolina, PR. At 4:00 p.m. on January 11, 2021, Employee #1 from Police Department #1 responded to a vehicle crash when one of the drivers involved in the crash opened fire on him with an AK-47 killing him instantly. The driver then car jacked a vehicle and took off toward the airport. Employee #2 from and Employee #3, both from Police Department #2, pursued the driver until he stopped and shot Employee #2, killing him. Employee #3 was injured in the leg and hospitalized. events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Centro M?Dico Del Turabo Inc. Bayamon, PR. An employee was working as a nursing aide, orderly, or attendant at a general medical or surgical hospital. She provided nursing services to patients who were not positive for COVID-19. Somehow she contracted COVID-19, because she tested positive for it. At 12:48 a.m. on September 2, 2020, she died.

events.title: One employee with COVID-19 infection dies, three are hospita…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Hospital Espanol Auxilio Mutuo De Pr Inc. Hato Rey, PR. Employees were working in a hospital when they were exposed to patients and coworkers infected with COVID-19. One employee contracted COVID-19 and subsequently died from her infection at 8:45 a.m. on April 3, 2020. Three other employees were infected with COVID-19 and required hospitalization for treatment but successfully recovered from their infections.

events.title: Employee falls to ground while talking with staff members an…
events.description: 1 worker death. Maricao, PR. At 8:30 a.m. on September 26, 2019, an employee was giving instruction to staff members when he fell to the floor, choking. The employee was transported to thehospital and died from asphyxiation.

events.title: Two employees are killed in oil tank explosion
events.description: 2 worker deaths. Yabucoa, PR. At 10:41 a.m. on June 25, 2019, Employees #1 and #2 were working at a multiemployer project at an oil refinery. They were welding a deck bridge between two oil tanks when an explosion occurred. Both employees were engulfed in flames and were killed.

events.title: Employee falls while pressure washing building and is killed…
events.description: 1 worker death. Puerto Nuevo, PR. At 10:30 a.m. on August 15, 2018, an employee was washing the building facade and lost his balance while on a ladder. The employee fell and hit his head against the pressure washer's handle, killing him.

events.title: Employee's shoulder touches energized 2400V wire while sweep…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Slsco Ltd. San Juan, PR. At 9:30 a.m. on April 21, 2018, an employee was sweeping the floor while a coworker was washing the roof. The employee's shoulder came into contact with a2400V energized electrical wire and was electrocuted.

events.title: Employee's shoulder touches an energized 2,400V wire while s…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Leonardo Veras Construction Corp. San Juan, PR. At 9:30 a.m. on April 21, 2018, an employee was sweeping the floor while a coworker was washing the roof. The employee's shoulder came into contact with a2,400V energized electrical wire and was electrocuted.

events.title: Employee falls and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Supermercado Agueybana Inc. Guanica, PR. On August 24, 2015, Employee #1 was standing on plywood, positioning a ladder on a mezzanine. The employee was securing a permanent ladder 24 feet from the top of the mezzanine to the first story level. The plywood shifted, causing Employee#1 to fall off of the ladder, hitting the concrete floor. He was killed from a cranial fracture that he sustained in the fall.
